name: Svelte
subtitle: Compiler-based UI framework (with SvelteKit)
creator: Rich Harris (then at The Guardian)
maintainer: Svelte core team; Harris works on it full time at Vercel
description: Svelte compiles components at build time into small JavaScript that updates the page directly, with no virtual DOM and little runtime code. SvelteKit is its full-stack framework, adding routing, server rendering, data loading, form actions and deployment adapters.

languages.youWrite: .svelte files (HTML, JS or TS, and CSS)

concepts.explanation: Work happens at build time, so less ships to the browser.
CSS in a component only affects that component.
Fetch data for a page on the server or client.
Deploy to Vercel, Netlify, Node or Cloudflare.

codeSamples.label: Svelte 5
codeSamples.code:
<script>
  let count = $state(0);
  let double = $derived(count * 2);
</script>

<button onclick={() => count++}>
  Clicked {count} times (double: {double})
</button>

pros: Most admired frontend framework in the Stack Overflow 2025 survey (62.4%)
cons: Smaller job market and library ecosystem than React
Svelte 5 runes changed syntax, so older tutorials are out of date

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
